title: M3.1: Slack verification spike and decisions
description:
Verify and record: current Slack app creation and distribution rules without Marketplace listing, required scopes (chat:write, chat:write.customize, app_mentions:read, im:history, im:read, users:read), Events API retry behavior and the 3 second acknowledgement, OAuth v2 install redirect on the same-origin front door, rate limits per method, behavior of per-message username override, and token storage in SSM SecureString at a path scoped role. Output: a comment with decisions and any corrections to contract section 10.3. Owner creates the Slack app (outside AWS) from the manifest the spike drafts.

Acceptance criteria:
- Manifest drafted and reviewed
- Findings that change the contract are recorded and the draft updated
- Owner question list for the Slack app creation is short and concrete

Gherkin: none (infrastructure or owner task); infra tests or a runbook are the evidence.

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).
